The frozen study is exact rather than sampled. One real renewal resets a nonstacking plan lifetime to eight physical service ticks and costs two service-tick units. Long-run direct return is service minus renewal cost per physical tick. One equal-physical-time stratum offers a real opportunity every tick and the other every four ticks. The exact regenerative identity is `J_Delta(q)=1-(1-q)^(8/Delta)-2q/Delta`. The unrestricted spacing-one optimum is `q=3/16`, direct return about `0.435073`, with near-optimal set `{3/16}`. The spacing-four optimum is `q=12/16`, direct return `0.5625`, with near-optimal set `{10/16,11/16,12/16,13/16,14/16}`.
